label: File Manager
description: Titan's file manager. Lists, finds, copies, moves and deletes files without opening a window, and navigates the open window when there is one.

actions.name: list_folder
actions.summary: List what is in a folder, with sizes. Defaults to the user's home folder.

actions.name: find_files
actions.summary: Find files and folders whose name contains some text, searching inside a folder and everything under it.

path.description: Where to search. Defaults to the user's home folder.

actions.name: folder_size
actions.summary: Say how much space a folder takes and how many files are in it.

actions.name: free_space
actions.summary: Say how much room is left on the drive holding a path.

path.description: Full path of the folder to create.

actions.name: copy_path
actions.summary: Copy a file or a whole folder. Never overwrites: a name that is taken gets a number.

destination.description: Where to put it - a folder, or the new full path.

actions.name: move_path
actions.summary: Move or rename a file or folder. Never overwrites.

destination.description: Where to put it - a folder, or the new full path.

actions.name: delete_path
actions.summary: Delete a file or folder. Goes to the Recycle Bin where Windows allows it.

actions.name: get_location
actions.summary: Say which folder the open file manager is showing and what is selected in it.

actions.name: go_to
actions.summary: Take the open file manager to a folder.

actions.name: refresh
actions.summary: Re-read the folder the file manager is showing.
